About IIT Delhi

IIT Delhi, established in 1961, stands as one of India's most prestigious technical institutions. Located in the heart of the national capital, it offers unparalleled access to India's top corporations, government bodies, and research organizations. Known for producing CXOs, Nobel laureates, and tech entrepreneurs, IIT Delhi's proximity to Delhi-NCR's booming startup ecosystem makes it uniquely positioned for industry collaboration.
